reviews.frank_statement: FRANK requires ClayCode to execute reusable typed behavior as part of a general-purpose runtime, but FRANK does not justify a FRANK-specific function primitive.
reviews.counterhypothesis: Existing rule/needle/cycle or a separate typed executable dialect can provide deterministic reusable definition->call semantics without adding fn to G9.
reviews.falsifier: The admitted production compiler executes APP-01..APP-10 and a real FRANK component with equivalent typed call semantics using existing constructs, or target reader/Ubuntu evidence rejects fn integration.
independent_checks: Current-run D+fn local parser/type/binding/lowering experiment: 20,000 cases, 0 differential mismatches; fail-closed negative corpus.
MLIR SymbolTable/SymbolRef design requires unique named symbols in a parent symbol table and explicit symbolic reference.
LLVM function types/calls bind argument types/signatures; WebAssembly validates function instance/type before invocation.
adversarial_checks: Undefined function, arity mismatch, undefined variable, duplicate function, duplicate param, return mismatch, unsupported recursion and untyped parameter all rejected.
Strict-LALR construction tested and failed for baseline D and D+fn, blocking conflict-free promotion.
ClayGraph exact-query negative result applied: no graph fallback for call target.
reviews.reason: Generic exact typed definition/call closure is independently supported as a compiler requirement and locally executable with the candidate; the exact source surface remains unselected and production/Ubuntu evidence is missing.
reviews.claycode_action: Keep fn only as non-promoted frontend candidate; integrate exact symbol/signature identity in canonical IR/compiler and test against alternatives.
affected_claycode_artifacts: future canonical typed IR/symbol table/type-effect checker
